extracted.name: How to Cook Frozen Meatballs in the Air Fryer
extracted.description: Use your air fryer to quickly cook frozen meatballs in very little time straight from the freezer. They turn out crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 380 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Spread out frozen meatballs in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Spray tops with cooking spray.
Cook in the air fryer for 4 minutes. Shake, and cook for an additional 4 minutes.
